blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Severe Tropical Storm Cempaka may enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) by Sunday evening or early Monday morning, when it will be named Samuel, but it will not directly affect the country, according to the weather bureau. In its 5 a.m. Sunday weather forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Cempaka was last spotted 1,865 kilometers east of extreme Northern Luzon as of 3 a.m. Pagasa weather specialist Obet Badrina said Cempaka was packing maximum sustained winds of 110 kilometers per hour (kph) and gusts of up to 135 kph.
